title: A counterexample to the coarse Novikov conjecture

abstractEnglish: We disprove the coarse Novikov conjecture: ordinary coarse assembly need not be rationally injective for uniformly discrete spaces of bounded geometry. We construct a coarse disjoint union of finite graphs of uniformly bounded degree and an infinite-order class in its degree-one coarse K-homology whose image under ordinary coarse assembly in the K-theory of the reduced, locally compact Roe algebra vanishes.
titleEn: A counterexample to the coarse Novikov conjecture

details.overview: 稿件否定粗Novikov猜想：摘要称对一致离散的有界几何空间，普通粗装配不必有理单射。作者构造有限图的粗不交并（度一致有界），并在其一次粗K同调中给出一个无限阶类，该类的像在约化局部紧Roe代数的K理论中经普通粗装配后为零。该结果若成立将对粗几何与指标理论中的Novikov型问题产生重大影响。
keyPoints: 构造度一致有界的有限图粗不交并作为反例空间。
给出一次粗K同调中的无限阶类，其粗装配像为零。
作者声称这否定粗Novikov猜想中有理单射性的一般陈述。
